shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "for f in pages/*.tsx package.json tsconfig.json next.config.ts .gitignore; do printf '\\n### %s\\n' \""'$f"; cat "$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json package.json && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!.next'"' -g '"'!__agent_eval__'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e 'async function check(path, title, description, text) { const response = await fetch(\"http://localhost:3100\" + path); const html = await response.text(); const checks = {status: response.status, title: html.includes(\"<title>\" + title + \"</title>\"), description: html.includes(\"content=\\\"\" + description + \"\\\"\"), content: html.includes(text)}; console.log(path, checks); if (response.status "'!== 200 || !checks.title || !checks.description || !checks.content) process.exitCode = 1; } Promise.all([check("/", "Home Page", "Welcome to our Next.js app", "Welcome to our Next.js application!"), check("/about", "About Us", "Learn more about us", "This is the about page of our Next.js application.")])'"'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- .gitignore tsconfig.json && rg -n "next/head|next/router|next/document|next/app|pages/" app tsconfig.json next.config.ts || true'
